title: [Decision] Triage priority caliber for protocol additions: keep 「协议新增定 p1」 for every addition, or grade additions an app asks for at p2 unless a release needs them
body:
Ruled: 6431014712 · letter A · 2026-10-27T01:00Z

Filing gate ②: a maintainer-only decision (a rule change to the triage yardstick; human-ruling floor #25344, "rules and process changes"). Maintainer, 2026-10-27, verbatim: 「立决策卡」, on the triage seat's list of open questions that had only been raised in round reports. Filed by the triage seat (`session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`, seat post #6015). ⛔ Not a claim. Dedupe: this question has been raised only in triage round reports and in triage comments ("the pending caliber question on app-driven additions"). No card carries it.

## 维护者速读

现行分诊口径是你定的「协议新增定 p1，其余 p2」，外加「发版本优先的都p1」。问题是：协议新增里有一大类是**某个应用提出来的**（HotCRM、hotclm 的业务需求），不是发版需要，但按现行口径一律 p1，和 18.2 发版任务抢同一批开发席位。请裁：**A** 维持现状，所有协议新增都是 p1；**甲（B）** 应用提出的协议新增默认 p2，被发版点名、或已经卡住下游上线的，仍按「发版本优先」升 p1；**C** 协议新增不再单独定级，和其他卡一样按影响定 p1/p2。选 A / 甲 / C？

## Governing text

- The triage yardstick: 「协议新增定 p1，其余 p2」 and 「发版本优先的都p1」 (maintainer, in the triage seat thread).
- 「暂时不考虑发布 v19，后续协议变更的也是 18.x，而且尽量不考虑退役阶段，协议变更直接处理」: protocol changes ship directly in 18.x.
- The human-ruling floor, #25344: priority policy is a rules change.

## Premises (measured 2026-10-27, 00:20Z)

- P1. Open p1 cards in this repo: 26 in total (devx 8, skills 7, spec 6, server 3, ui 1, cloud 1).
- P2. The protocol additions now graded p1 that an app or a downstream ruling asked for: #26304 (the read-only `record_link` screen field; hotcrm#2285 waits on it), #26314 (the approval lock read; ruled on #25934), and the skills halves that ride with them, #26347 and #26362. Earlier p1s of the same kind: #25777, #25778, #25779, #25786, #25788, #25800 and #25801, mostly landed now.
- P3. Neither #26304 nor #26314 is named by the 18.2.0 release card #25807.

## Options

| Option | What | Consequence | Workload |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| **A** | Keep: every protocol addition is p1. | The release and app asks share the p1 pool. Today's four p1s stay p1. | none |
| **甲 (B)** | An addition an app asks for defaults to p2. It goes up to p1 when the release names it, or when it blocks a downstream go-live with a date. | The p1 pool shrinks to release work and blockers. #26304 and #26314 drop to p2 unless one of those arms applies. hotcrm#2285 waits longer unless HotCRM gives a date. | triage relabels 4 cards; no PR |
| **C** | Drop the protocol rule: grade every card by impact like any other. | Simplest, but "protocol additions first" is no longer a rule. | triage relabels as cards come in; no PR |

## Recommendation

**A**, for now. #26304 and #26314 are the only live app-driven p1 additions, both are already ruled by you, and both close a gap where the console offers what the server refuses. The p1 pool (26) is not crowding out the release today. If the pool grows past the release's capacity, 甲 is the lever. Triage would re-raise it then, with the count.

## After the ruling

The triage seat applies the letter on its next round and records it on #6015. 甲 or C relabels the affected cards in one stroke, with a comment on each.

os-decision-facets
① 项目长远合理性：A 不新增特例；甲 新增「应用驱动」与「发版点名、下游阻塞」两条判定，口径更细，但需要分诊逐张判断。
② 实际业务拉动：今天受影响的有 4 张 p1（#26304、#26314、#26347、#26362）；p1 池共 26 张，暂未挤占 18.2 发版。
③ 防 AI 犯错：A 是闭合规则，分诊不用判断来源；甲 依赖分诊判断「是不是应用提出的」，有误判空间。
④ 创业阶段不扩散：三案都不新增门禁或脚本，只改分诊口径。
Prior rulings read: 协议新增定 p1 · 发版本优先的都p1 · app-driven caliber → 2 maintainer yardstick lines (triage seat thread), no card; ADR none; thread: #6015
